apple should really stick to what they're good at: building hardware and operating systems. They're fumbling in the cloud space.

Do you know that they don't even sell iPod Classics anymore? I was looking into getting one becayse none of the iPhones or iPod Touches provide anything larger than 64GB of storage space. I have over 100 GB of music in my iTunes library and the leading music store, the company that helped to revolutionize the way we listen to music, doesn't even offer a player that can store more than 64GB worth of music. Which is absolutely ridiculous considering that iTunes also sells movies, books, TV shows, music videos, etc. The old iPod classics used to offer up to 160 GB of storage, but now they don't even make the Classic model anymore. Just the Shuffle, Nano, and Touch, none of which hold more than 32 GB. That isn't even half of my library.

I am a huge consumer of music, so of course I have more music than the average iTunes user, but still there isn't a word for this kind of stupidity. I ended up buying a Moto E with a 128 GB microSD and used iSyncr to sync my iTunes library. Once again, Android just stomps all over Apple. This company needs to get their shit together or they'll lose ground in the one area they're known for...hardware and music players. I could give a flying shit about the Cloud.
